content.title: NCIS's 500th Episode Delivers Its BEST Death In 23 Years
content.text: Paramount Express Published Mar 24, 2026, 8:59 PM EDT Ana Dumaraog is a Writer and Editor at Screen Rant, where she expertly covers Network TV offerings, among other things She has spearheaded the effort to make the site an authority on broadcast shows, initially starting with The Big Bang Theory franchise, NCIS, and One Chicago before taking on the specialization in general. Ana has also covered a wide-spread of topics in the past — from franchises like, the MCU and Star Wars, to classic TV favorites, such as Frasier and MASH. Ana brings clarity and enthusiasm to every story she tackles—whether reporting on new releases or offering deep dives into fan-favorite franchises. Her coverage translates complex entertainment developments into engaging, audience-focused content. Sign in to your Screen Rant account Warning! Spoilers ahead for NCIS season 23, episode 13, "All Good Things."NCIS season 23, episode 13 is a major milestone for the procedural, and it changes the course of its future. One of the longest-running scripted series on TV, the show is now widely regarded as an institution. Premiering in 2003, it has gone through a lot of phases throughout that history, with the last few years particularly tricky, on the heels of Leroy Jethro Gibbs' retirement in NCIS season 19. Amid all that, it remains a major ratings hit for the broadcaster, being one of the most-watched series during the 2025-2026 TV cycle. NCIS's 500th Milestone Marks The Death Of Leon Vance Paramount Press As first revealed in episode 12, NCIS goes through with the shut-down of the agency. Instead of tackling the story in a linear fashion, showrunner Steven D. Binder and the writers decided on a more creative way to tell the story. As the MCRT gets scattered, the case of Billy Fuentes comes into their lap. For long-time watchers of NCIS, the character might be familiar, as he was the young kid that Gibbs helped in the show's very second episode. All committed to keeping the promise that their former leader made, everyone reconvenes to help his sister who is being accused of murder. What's Next For NCIS After Vance's Death? Related CBS Officially Ends NCIS After 34 Years In a jaw-dropping plot twist, CBS ends NCIS season 23, episode 12 with the massive revelation that the agency is officially shutting down. The big question now is who will fill in the shoes that Vance left? Now that he's gone, there's a power vacuum left in the agency. For nearly two decades, he was the fair protector of NCIS — firm and principled, but was always supportive of his team. He ushered in the show's transition from Gibbs to Parker. Whoever ends up occupying his office will have massive shoes to fill. The great news is that NCIS already has the perfect replacement — Timothy McGee. It's the easiest path, considering how capable Sean Murray's character has been. While there's no doubt that he will be great in the role, Vance will be sorely missed. SIGN UP NOW!
